blocks.text: Fossil has always been inspired by American creativity and ingenuity. Since 1984, we've strived to bring new life into the industry by making quality, fashionable watches and accessories that were both fun and accessible. Our Adjust-O-Matic closure allows you to self-adjust the size of Virginia's strap or bracelet, making it the perfect gift that she can wear right away! This Fossil watch women will love is great for modern sophisticates and vintage enthusiasts alike.

items.label: EFFORTLESS STYLE
items.value: Shiny steel meets dramatic glitz – made for sophisticates and vintage fans alike; our ever-chic Virginia shines; this Fossil jewelry for women features three-hand movement on a rose gold stainless steel bracelet*

items.label: CASE & MOVEMENT
items.value: Just one of many Fossil watches for women, this analog watch has a 30mm case, 14mm band width, hardened mineral crystal lens resists scratches, and an accurate Quartz movement with a 3-hand day-date analog display, imported

items.label: ELEGANT DIAL
items.value: These women's watches feature a round rose gold stainless steel case, with a silver dial and glitz accents

items.label: WRIST WATCH BAND
items.value: Rose gold, durable stainless steel bracelet with an Adjust-O-Matic closure; up to two links can be easily removed without the use of a tool from this self-adjustable band

items.label: WATER RESISTANT LADIES WATCH
items.value: Up to 50m (165ft); wearable for short periods of recreational swimming and showering, but not diving or snorkeling; 5 ATM
